recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring two overlapping square album covers set against a textured, gradient background. The layout uses heavy drop shadows to create depth and a distinct hierarchy between the main title text and the featured artwork.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping square frames creating a diagonal flow from top-left to bottom-right
High-contrast white display text against a dark, textured background
Consistent drop shadows on all floating elements to simulate physical layering
Color-coordinated typography that mirrors the palette of the internal album art
coreInvariants: Square aspect ratio for internal image frames
Heavy black drop shadows on all text and image blocks
Textured, grainy background with a vertical color gradient

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary image squares occupy the center-left and center-right, scaled to roughly 40% of the total canvas width each.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold sans-serif name in the upper right and lower left quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves in a 'Z' pattern, starting at the top-left image, moving to the top-right text, down to the bottom-left text, and finishing on the bottom-right image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured background serves as active negative space, framing the central collage elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and purple gradient background with a grainy, stippled texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary display text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and warm earth tones within the photography and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark background; muted, natural saturation within the photographic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in ultra-bold, wide geometric sans-serif
Secondary titles in a condensed, italicized serif with high stroke contrast
Heavy, soft-edged drop shadows applied to all text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif paired with a warm, traditional italic serif for a 'modern-vintage' 70s look.
graphicDevices: Thin white borders on image frames

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy-weight uppercase display text.
Captures the soft, 1970s serif aesthetic for the subtitles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured gradient background transitioning from deep teal at the bottom to muted purple at the top with a heavy film grain. Place two square photo frames with thin white borders, one in the top-left and one in the bottom-right, both with heavy black drop shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in white Futura Extra Bold uppercase in the top-right and bottom-left quadrants. Directly beneath, add the title text in golden-yellow Souvenir Bold Italic. Apply a 45-degree black drop shadow to all text.

verificationChecks: Check that all elements have a consistent drop shadow direction.
Ensure the background texture is visible but does not obscure text.
Verify the white borders on the image squares are thin and crisp.

postGenerationChecks: Is the drop shadow consistent across all layers?
Does the grain texture feel organic to the 1970s era?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the two font styles?
Do the image frames overlap in a way that creates depth?
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered square frames + heavy drop shadows + geometric/serif font pairing + grainy gradient background.
